subject: Sponsor lane & security gates — post-demo confirmation and next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kim Lee <kim@finpath.com>, Ari Goldstein <ari.goldstein@finpath.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Sponsor lane & security gates — post-demo confirmation and next steps

Thanks all for joining the demo earlier — appreciate the candid feedback. Short recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Key takeaways
- Prod fit: FinPath liked the latency profile and the sandbox inference cost estimates we showed.
- Decision criteria: Ari called out three must-haves — (1) predictable per-token economics, (2) data isolation for PII, (3) SOC2 + audit log retention policy.
- Procurement path: Kim indicated procurement will own contracting, and they'll need an SOW + pricing sheet to review.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Can Kim confirm the final list of reviewers on your side (legal, IT security, procurement) and an internal timeline for the procurement review? (Kim)
2) We'll send an ROI one-pager tailored to the pilot and a draft SOW for procurement to review by EOD tomorrow. (Jordan / Soojin)
3) Security: we'll attach our SOC2 summary and a short questionnaire; if FinPath prefers, security can run a vendor security call next week. (Jordan)

Proposed dates
- Procurement sync: week of 6/19 — propose Tue 6/20 10:00am PT
- Security deep-dive: week of 6/19 — propose Wed 6/21 9:00am PT

Attachments: finpath-demo-screens.pdf (screenshots), proposal-template.docx (pricing + SOW template)

Would appreciate a confirmation of the procurement reviewer list and the preferred time for the procurement sync.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference
A: 1 (415) 555-0123
From: Kim Lee <kim@finpath.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ari Goldstein <ari.goldstein@finpath.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finpath.com>
Date: 2028-06-12T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor lane & security gates — post-demo confirmation and next steps

Jordan — thanks for the recap. Quick answers:
- Economic buyer: Ari is correct; he'll lead the business case and approval.
- Procurement reviewers: procurement@finpath.com, legal (sarah.lee@finpath.com), IT security (sec.vendor@finpath.com).
- Timeline: target procurement review complete by 6/30; legal/IT security will do a parallel review but expect questions.

We do need the SOW and pricing sheet to start. Also security will want your SOC2 report and a filled vendor questionnaire — I'll send the questionnaire before EOD.

Procurement please add any additional constraints (data residency, liability caps).

Kim
Kim Lee
Head of Partnerships, FinPath
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-12T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor lane & security gates — post-demo confirmation and next steps

Jordan / Marissa — drafting the ROI one-pager now; I'll tailor it to Ari's cost-savings metrics (token economics + expected latency improvements for 95th pctile flows).

I'll also start the SOW draft from the proposal-template.docx and flag two clauses for legal to review early (data handling and termination assistance). Attaching a first pass.

Attachment: ROI-onepager-Redwood.pdf

I'll be available to join the procurement sync and can own the security questionnaire responses so legal doesn't get blocked by numbers.

-Soojin
Soojin Lee | Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kim Lee <kim@finpath.com>, Ari Goldstein <ari.goldstein@finpath.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finpath.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-12T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor lane & security gates — post-demo confirmation and next steps

Great — appreciate the quick reply and the reviewer list, Kim.

Summary / commitments from Redwood
- By 6/13 EOD: send SOW + pricing sheet and SOC2 summary; Soojin will circulate the ROI one-pager.
- Week of 6/19: schedule procurement sync (Jordan & Soojin attending). I'll send two time options: Tue 6/20 10:00am PT or Thu 6/22 11:00am PT — please indicate which works.
- Security questionnaire: Kim — once you send the questionnaire, Soojin will complete and return within 48 hours. If security prefers a live call, we can set aside 30 minutes during the week of 6/19.

Open questions for FinPath (to confirm before we draft SOW)
- Any minimum pilot duration you expect (30/60/90 days)?
- Is there an internal PO / pre-approval step procurement needs before signing an SOW?

Links: HubSpot deal (FT-00123) and DocuSign template for expedited routing.

Thanks — talk soon.
Jordan

--

Redwood Inference
